algorithm: Enumerate compatible signatures from original repository sources. Ask for only documented success relations. Restore exact source receipts. Insert a consumer after an existing producer/error guard on the same local receiver. Preserve the complete original test.

limitations: A verified quotation proves provenance, not semantic entailment.
